'Interests shape a meal, and the owner removed the crafts.' and 'Interests reward an hour, as removed crafts did.' both pass as dated. Checked by running the file's own regexes in node.

tests/evidence3-person.test.ts:626 (and b13:390). REMOVAL's 'went' lookahead accepts 'went on|in the|at', so 'Interests went on lifting a meal.', 'Interests went in the pot.' and 'Interests went at full value into every meal.' pass. These are kin of the 'went into' case the tightening claims to close.

tests/evidence3-person.test.ts:626/632. A removal participle in an appositive or relative clause dates a present claim: 'The interests, removed by the owner, lift a meal.' and 'Interests, which the owner removed, still lift a meal.' both pass.
